squash-domesticated-guila-naquitz.description: A kneeling, bare-chested man with long black hair and a shell necklace sits at the mouth of a rock cave, pressing small pale seeds into a patch of dirt. A pale gourd bowl and a flat stone slab with plant fragments lie beside him. Cave walls with faint pictographs frame the scene, and a dry desert valley with shrubs and mountains is visible through the entrance. The painting is an oil-style image that fills the canvas edge to edge, with no visible text.

cacao-use-santa-ana-la-florida.description: Weathered brown hands split open a ridged cacao pod with white seeds inside, held over a carved grey stone bowl containing a few cacao beans. A dark spouted clay vessel with a loop handle sits to the right. Dense dark jungle with hanging vines fills the background. Oil-painting style, filling the whole frame, with no visible text, frame or border.

zapotecs-found-monte-alban.description: Several men with dark skin and loincloths work on a rocky hilltop. A large man in the foreground carries a woven basket of earth on his back, with a headband across his forehead. Others shovel and sift dirt into baskets. On the right, a stone wall with stepped courses, a stairway and carved relief figures rises toward a top platform. Behind and below, a hazy valley with a winding river and a cloudy sky.

el-mirador-maya-city-rises.description: A huge stepped stone pyramid with a wide central staircase rises from dense jungle under a cloudy sky. Three small temple houses with thatched roofs crown the summit, and stucco masks decorate the upper facades. Small figures in plain dress move on the terraces and stairs, with some scaffolding on the right and a few small fires and smoke near the base. The painting fills the whole frame in an oil-painting style, with no visible text.

teotihuacan-city-founded.description: Men in loincloths and cloaks pull a taut rope across a dry, open valley floor. One kneels and drives a stake at the rope's end. Others set stone blocks and upright posts along the line. Low stepped stone platforms stand in the mid-distance, and dark mountains rise under a dramatic sky with sunbeams breaking through the clouds.

chiapa-de-corzo-long-count-stela.description: A shirtless man in a loincloth kneels in a dark forest with fire glowing in the background, swinging a stone hammer onto a chisel set against a tall, upright stone slab. The slab's face is covered in worn, carved relief that looks like glyphs or figures, with no legible characters. The setting is rough and natural, with rocks and foliage on the ground. The frame is edge to edge with no border.

lord-of-sipan-burial.description: A dark, low-lit tomb chamber with mud-brick walls and wooden roof beams. In the foreground an open wooden plank coffin holds a skeleton wearing a gold helmet-like headdress, a turquoise and gold beaded necklace and round gold ear ornaments, with more beads scattered on the floor. A torch on the right casts a shaft of light. Pottery vessels and woven baskets sit on the earthen floor. No text is visible, and the painting runs edge to edge.

teotihuacan-conquers-tikal.description: A warrior with a large feathered headdress and a spear stands in the foreground, with a column of spear-carrying warriors behind him holding round and rectangular shields with painted faces. Behind them rise red and white stepped pyramids with stairways in a jungle setting, with smoke and torches in the air. On the right, townspeople in cloth and feathers watch, some holding small fires. No text, numbers or frame are visible, and the painting fills the image edge to edge.

copan-dynasty-founded.description: A man in a feathered headdress with a jade bead necklace, ear spools and a round carved shield stands in the foreground holding a staff. Behind him, several figures carry baskets along a forest path. The setting is a tropical river valley with thatched huts and a stepped stone pyramid at right. Clothing and architecture look Maya or Mesoamerican, with no visible letters, numbers or frame. The painting runs edge to edge.

teotihuacan-burned-collapse.description: A night scene of a stepped stone pyramid with a temple on top, its stairways and flanking structures on fire with heavy dark smoke and sparks. A large dark pyramid sits in the background, and a crowd of small figures runs across a paved stone plaza in the foreground. No visible text, frame or wounds.

calakmul-defeats-tikal.description: A painted scene of Maya-style warriors climbing a stone staircase of a pyramid-temple. In the centre a figure with dark skin raises a tall standard topped with a carved feathered serpent head. Other warriors with round shields and spears surge up the steps on both sides, and a few figures are on the upper landing near a dark doorway. The stonework is weathered, with mist and trees behind. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text apart from a tiny mark in the bottom-right corner, and nothing gory is shown.

pakal-tomb-sealed-palenque.description: A dim vaulted stone chamber with carved relief panels on the walls. Several bare-chested men with torches push and steady a large carved stone slab hung on ropes above an open stone sarcophagus. A green jade-masked figure lies inside the sarcophagus. Smoke drifts near the torches, and the scene is painted in warm browns and oranges with no visible text.

tikal-temple-i-built.description: A large stepped stone pyramid rises from a jungle clearing under a dramatic dusk sky. Wooden scaffolding wraps the upper tiers, with small figures working on the top and climbing the steep central staircase. A temple doorway with a carved facade sits at the summit, and a stela, a small fire and a thatched hut appear at the base. The painting is edge to edge with no visible text, frame or wall.

chan-chan-rises.description: A shirtless, dark-skinned man in a loincloth leans over a wooden mould on a mud-brick wall, pressing wet earth into it. The wall has carved relief friezes of fish and birds. Other workers are in a trench behind him, stacked earthen bricks stand at the right, and a stormy sunset sea sits in the background.

chichen-itza-rises.description: A large stepped stone pyramid with a steep central staircase and a temple on top, with two carved feathered-serpent heads flanking the base of the stairs. Crowds of people in plain ancient-style dress fill a dusty plaza below, with thatched huts at the edges. Dramatic storm clouds with sunbeams break over the scene, and there is a distant treeline. The painting is edge to edge with no visible text, frame or border.

cusco-founded-legend.description: An older man with long black hair under a patterned headband, wearing a red and brown woven poncho with geometric bands, a gold earring and a gold pendant, leans forward and drives a long gold staff into the dirt of a grassy hillside. Behind him, three people in dark shawls watch, one holding a bundle to her chest and another carrying a pack on his back with a walking stick. The setting is a high, rocky mountain valley under a heavy storm sky with bright light breaking through the clouds. No text, border or frame is visible, and nothing is graphic.

pachacuti-becomes-inca.description: A seated man in a red and gold patterned tunic and a gold-banded headdress with white and black feathers raises a gold axe-scepter. He sits on a silver and gold litter carried on poles by bearers, surrounded by a crowd of warriors with spears, shields and raised fists. Behind them are stone terraces and walls, steep green mountains, and a misty sunlit sky. The image is a painterly scene with no visible text, no border, and no blood.

inca-conquer-chimu.description: A man with a headband and a patterned tunic holds a spiked, star-headed mace over his shoulder, with a cord hanging from his other hand. Behind him, spear-carrying guards and barefoot workers with hammers and an anvil walk past a carved stone gateway in a painted, warm-toned oil style.

tenochtitlan-conquers-tlatelolco.description: A painted scene of a stepped Mesoamerican pyramid with twin shrines on top. A warrior in a feathered headdress with a wooden sword leads a charge up the steps, beside a man in a jaguar-patterned suit. Defenders fight on the stairs and some climb them. On the lakeshore at left, crowds with baskets of produce and cloth stand near canoes on the water, with smoke and fire in the sky at top left. The painting runs edge to edge with no visible text, frame or border.

templo-mayor-dedicated.description: A painted scene of a large stepped stone pyramid with two shrine temples on its summit, smoke and flames rising from the shrines under a dark stormy sky. Long processions of small dark figures, some with feathered headdresses and banners, climb the twin staircases, and a dense crowd with torches fills the plaza in the foreground. No visible text, border or wounds.

moctezuma-ii-crowned.description: A man in a feathered headdress and spotted jaguar-skin cloak places his hands on the head of a man in a turquoise and white embroidered mantle wearing a turquoise crown, whose arms are raised. They stand in a stone temple courtyard with carved walls, columns, incense smoke and fire braziers. Kneeling and standing attendants in feathered headdresses and woven garments watch, some with hands pressed together. No visible text, border or frame.
